info.title: fsxpired reports outdated #r "nuget" references in F# scripts.
info.description: Reports and updates outdated "#r nuget" references in F# scripts.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description:
Walk one script through every step and report what
happened at each: the directives found, the loads
resolved, whether nuget.org answered, and the verdict
for each reference with its reason.

options.name: --prerelease
options.description: Let stable pins move to, and be compared against, prereleases.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Print this page and exit.
Paths:
One .fsx file. A folder is refused: the answers differ per file.
Exit codes:
0  every step ran
1  a step failed
2  the arguments were wrong

options.name: --update
options.description: Rewrite each outdated exact pin to the latest version it may move to.

options.name: --prerelease
options.description: Let stable pins move to, and be compared against, prereleases.

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the report as JSON to stdout, everything else to stderr.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Print this page and exit.
Paths:
Files and folders. A folder is searched recursively for .fsx files, skipping
bin, obj, node_modules, .git and whatever .gitignore excludes. No paths means
the current folder. A script's #load chain is followed.
Exit codes:
0  nothing outdated, or every outdated pin was rewritten
1  at least one reference is outdated
2  unexpected error: unreadable file, nuget.org unreachable, unsupported directive
3  a file could not be written
